teaser.en: A strong-smelling roadside mint named after the spirit it is used against.
teaser.sw: Mmea wa jamii ya mnanaa wenye harufu kali unaoota kando ya barabara, uliopewa jina la pepo unaotumika dhidi yake.
teaser.dg: Mmea wa jamii ya *mint* wenye arufu kali, unaomera kanda-kanda ya njira, na unaihwa kpwa dzina ra pepho ambaye nkuhumirwa kumzuwiya.

summary.en: Pungahewa is a tall, hairy, strongly scented weed of the mint family, originally from tropical America. The Digo use it as a medicine against a particular spirit, punga hewa, which gives the plant its name.
summary.sw: Pungahewa ni gugu refu lenye manyoya na harufu kali, la familia ya minanaa, asili yake ikiwa Amerika ya kitropiki. Wadigo hulitumia kama dawa dhidi ya pepo maalumu, punga hewa, ambaye ndiye aliyeupa mmea jina lake.
summary.dg: Pungahewa ni mbondo, mmea mure wa jamii ya *mint* wenye nyere na arufu kali, ambao ni wa kula Amerika ya tsi za dzoho. Adigo nkuuhumira dza dawa ya kuzuwiya pepho mmwenga hasa, *punga hewa*, ambaye ndiye ariyeupha mmea uhu dzinare.

about.en:
*Pungahewa* is a coarse, upright herb up to about 2 metres tall, with square, hairy stems and soft, toothed leaves. Brush past it and it gives off a strong minty, resinous smell.

The small blue to purple flowers sit in the leaf angles. Each develops in a hairy, ribbed, bell-shaped calyx with bristly teeth that dries around the seeds. The Digo identify it by its leaves and fruits.
about.sw:
*Pungahewa* ni mmea mgumu uliosimama wima, wenye urefu wa hadi takriban mita 2, wenye mashina ya pembe nne yenye manyoya na majani laini yenye meno. Ukiupitia na kuugusa, hutoa harufu kali kama ya mnanaa na utomvu.

Maua madogo ya rangi ya buluu hadi zambarau hukaa kwenye pembe za majani. Kila moja hukua ndani ya kikombe cha ua chenye manyoya, chenye mistari na umbo la kengele, chenye meno kama nywele ngumu, kinachokauka kuzunguka mbegu. Wadigo huutambua kwa majani na matunda yake.
about.dg:
*Pungahewa* ni mmea mgumu unaoima chocho, hadi mita 2 hivi dzulu, wenye mihi ya pembe nne yenye nyere, na makodza laini genye meno. Uchiutsupa na kuuguta, unalavya arufu kali dza ya *mint* na ya utomvu.

Maruwa madide ga samawati hadi zambarau ganamera phatu makodza ganaphogbwirana na muhi. Chila ruwa rinakula ndani ya chikombe cha umbo ra kengele, chenye nyere na mistari, na meno ga nyere ngumu, ambacho chinauma chichizunguluka tembe. Adigo anaumanya kpwa makodzage na matundage.

where.en: It came from tropical America and is now a common weed of roadsides, abandoned fields, village edges and disturbed bush along the coast, often in dense stands.
where.sw: Ulitoka Amerika ya kitropiki na sasa ni gugu la kawaida kando ya barabara, kwenye mashamba yaliyotelekezwa, pembezoni mwa vijiji na vichaka vilivyovurugwa kote pwani, mara nyingi ukiota kwa wingi.
where.dg: Mmea uhu ni wa kula Amerika ya tsi za dzoho, na sambi ni mbondo ya kawaida kanda-kanda ya njira, mindani iriyorichwa, kanda-kanda ya vidzidzi na weruni phatu phariphobanangwa pwani yosi. Mara nyinji unamera kpwa mabunda manji ganayobanana.

uses.en: Pakia records that it is used as a spiritual medicine against a specific spirit, *punga hewa*. Elsewhere in the tropics the pungent leaves are widely burned or hung up to keep mosquitoes and other insects away.
uses.sw: Pakia anaripoti kwamba hutumika kama dawa ya kiroho dhidi ya pepo maalumu, *punga hewa*. Kwingineko katika nchi za joto, majani yake yenye harufu kali huchomwa au kutundikwa sana ili kufukuza mbu na wadudu wengine.
uses.dg: Pakia anaandika kukala nkuhumirwa dza dawa ya pepho, kuzuwiya pepho mmwenga hasa, *punga hewa*. Phatu phanjina pha tsi za dzoho, makodzage genye arufu kali nkuochwa au nkudeleswa sana ili imbu na adudu anjina asifike.

culture.en: Pakia lists *punga hewa* among the spirits that bring on illnesses, alongside *mwanga*, *mwanga jine* and *chirehani*. Plants used to cure those illnesses are named after the spirit, so the plant and the spirit share one name.
culture.sw: Pakia anaorodhesha *punga hewa* miongoni mwa pepo wanaoleta maradhi, pamoja na *mwanga*, *mwanga jine* na *chirehani*. Mimea inayotumika kuponya maradhi hayo hupewa jina la pepo husika, kwa hiyo mmea na pepo hushiriki jina moja.
culture.dg: Pakia anaandika *punga hewa* kahi ya pepho anaoreha makongo, phamwenga na *mwanga*, *mwanga jine* na *chirehani*. Mimea inayohumirwa kuphoza makongo higo nkuihwa kpwa dzina ra pepho, kpwa hivyo dzina ra mmea na ra pepho ni mwenga.

names.en: Pakia records *pungahewa*, named after the spirit *punga hewa*. In English it is pignut, bush mint or wild spikenard. No Swahili name is recorded. Botanists now often call it *Mesosphaerum suaveolens*.
names.sw: Pakia anaripoti *pungahewa*, uliopewa jina la pepo *punga hewa*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *pignut*, *bush mint* au *wild spikenard*. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili lililoripotiwa. Wataalamu wa mimea sasa mara nyingi huuita *Mesosphaerum suaveolens*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *pungahewa*, dzina ra kula kpwa pepho *punga hewa*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *pignut*, *bush mint* au *wild spikenard*. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili ririroandikpwa. Sambi asayansi a mimea mara nyinji anauiha *Mesosphaerum suaveolens*.

conservation.en: It is an invasive weed in much of Africa and Asia.
conservation.sw: Ni gugu vamizi katika sehemu kubwa ya Afrika na Asia.
conservation.dg: Ni mbondo inayovamira tsi kpwenye seemu nyinji za Afrika na Asia.
